name: Seadramon (X Antibody)
main_effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon to the bottom of the deck. Then, if [Seadramon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, 1 of your opponent's Tamers can't suspend until the end of their turn.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
